pullRequests.title: Reload notification-lag sessions without cancelling running turns
pullRequests.summary: When ZeroCode's notification stream overflowed, recovery cancelled running turns, including background sessions. The fix reattaches to the client's own running turns, keeps displayed output, and reloads the saved transcript again when the turn ends. Reconnect and resume paths retain their existing cancellation behavior.

pullRequests.title: Deliver mid-turn steering at the next step
pullRequests.summary: Follow-up messages sent while an agent was using tools waited until its final answer, and cancellation could lose them. The fix pauses the tool loop when steering is waiting and delivers the message at the next step within the same turn. A long tool call still runs to completion before the agent reads the message.

pullRequests.title: Close the steering channel before a turn finishes
pullRequests.summary: A finishing turn could acknowledge a follow-up message and then exit without reading it. The fix closes the steering channel before the turn finishes and checks once more for messages already accepted. Later messages receive a closed-channel response so the client can send them as ordinary prompts.
